Layered mixes: base (area shares + spacing), overlay (own density), drift (coverage); each layer is its own 100 %; 4 system templates exist
World-anchored lattice: the same mix gives identical candidates (ids and x/y) in overlapping windows; two mixes differ
Cell Fill: counts follow each layer (base ≈ area × Σ share × hex density, overlay ≈ area × density); changing the overlay density changes overlay plants only
Live brush: staged instances grow DURING the drag (before pointer-up), the stroke crosses two beds and the walk, the commit is one undo step, no plant outside a cell
Repeating the same stroke adds nothing (same lattice ids, no stacking); Esc cancel leaves the state unchanged; undo / redo one stroke
Brush affects only its footprint: plants of the same cells outside the stroke keep their coordinates; other beds untouched
Overlay-only stroke: the existing matrix (base) under the stroke is kept, only overlay plants change
Freeze: a frozen cell is skipped by the brush, by Cell Fill and by a shared mix edit
Local variant changes only the selected cells; Auto Compose fills only unplanted cells with the same engine (plants carry lattice ids)
FIXTURE distribution: same area, same plant count, same presence — different flowering counts give different fraction and per m² (unknown counted apart)
Save → reload (restore) keeps fragments, layers, plant ids / x / y, locks and strategy; export has z per plant and assumptions
Base model unchanged by the V2 design (baseline placements identical)
Internal cell edges are computational, not walls: plants grow within 0.08 m of an internal edge; none within 0.08 m of the bed (hard) boundary
Spacing is checked across cell edges (same layer ≥ 0.6 × the smaller spacing, other layers ≥ 0.12 m) and the internal-edge band is not emptier than the interior
Hover and stroke are the same evaluation: the plants a hover shows at a point are exactly the plants a click-stroke there commits; hover writes nothing
Light: open ground without an assumption is UNKNOWN (not sun); a project assumption makes fits known; a known conflict is swapped or skipped, kept only with an explicit override (flagged)
Blocked is not a conflict: centred on the walk the hover adds nothing on the path and names the path; a frozen cell is named frozen and untouched
Soft edge: inside the core every old base plant of the footprint is replaced; in the outer band part of the old community stays (a transition, not a seam); other layers untouched
FIXTURE components: the largest group is the largest by AREA (3 small linked cells vs 1 large cell), and its share is that area / resource area
Planted area is the painted footprint, not the whole cell: a partial stroke counts its clipped area; per m² uses it; structural area is reported apart
Cell-scoped undo snapshot (V3): a stroke undo / redo restores exactly that stroke; other cells keep their plants and the full state equals the pre-stroke state
Explore inspector reads the real community: the plants it lists are exactly the placed plants of the fragments under the click (all layers at that point), extended to the same stroke in other cells
Scope ≠ focus: confirming a new strategy never drops a bed that already has cells (the scope keeps it)
